## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue.

## Numerical and compatibility impact

State whether public signatures, values, units, outcomes, tolerances, or
dependency/toolchain versions change. For numerical changes, link the independent
reference evidence, affected cases, and updated compatibility record. For other
changes, state why numerical behavior is unchanged.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Include affected regression and
mutation witnesses for numerical changes, and controlled before/after measurements
for performance changes. Identify remaining limitations.
